heading: EXT. HANGING BRIDGE OF SPIDERSILK - ABOVE THE MOONLIT CHASM - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. HANGING BRIDGE OF SPIDERSILK - ABOVE THE MOONLIT CHASM - NIGHT
Wind howls.
A bridge of woven silver thread spans a bottomless gorge.
Far below, pale lights drift like fallen stars.
QUEEN ISOLDE VANTERRE, 40s, crowned in antlers of white bone, grips the rail.
Her cloak snaps in the gale.
Opposite her, at the far end of the span: MORVAN THE UNMADE, ageless, a figure of black smoke and one burning eye.
You have no claim on this valley.
units.name: QUEEN ISOLDE

units.text: The valley has no claim on you, and yet you bleed for it.
units.name: MORVAN

units.text: She steps onto the bridge.
Threads hum beneath her boots.
Go back to your cold hollow, Morvan.
units.name: QUEEN ISOLDE

units.text: Come and make me.
units.name: MORVAN

units.text: A horn sounds from the castle far behind her.
Isolde does not turn.
Smoke rolls along the silver strands.
Majesty! The east wall has fallen! Return at once!
units.name: ROYAL HERALD

units.text: Hold the gate!
units.name: QUEEN ISOLDE

units.text: She draws a pale sword from her belt.
It blazes white.
Morvan lifts a hand; the smoke thickens into a spear of shadow.
You cannot be in two places, little queen.
units.name: MORVAN

units.text: I am not in two places. I am here.
units.name: QUEEN ISOLDE

units.text: She runs.
The bridge sways.
The spear hurls.
Her blade meets it in a burst of light, and the gorge rings like a bell.
Then fall here.
units.name: MORVAN

units.text: Not while a thread holds.
units.name: QUEEN ISOLDE

units.text: She drives forward.
Smoke breaks around her.
The silver strands blaze.
Morvan roars.
The wind does not let up.
